name: Chamunda Electrical Ltd
about: Founded in June 2013, Chamunda Electricals Limited specializes in operating and maintaining substations and generating 1.5 MW of solar power. [1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile:[1]
Chamunda Electricals specializes in:
- Operation & Maintenance of electrical substations (up to 66 KV).
- Testing & Commissioning of electrical substations (up to 220 KV).
- Solar Power Generation, operating a 1.5 MW solar park in Gujarat.
- Erection of Extra High Voltage (EHV) Class Equipment (up to 220 KV).

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 27.2%
Promoter holding has increased by 1.01% over last quarter.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Debtor days have increased from 54.3 to 76.8 days.
Working capital days have increased from 32.0 days to 104 days
